text:
Mara: Kickoff — RetailOne POC. Need to agree on 3 prioritized endpoints, eval prompts, 4-week timeline, and security asks. @alex_retail can you confirm main business metric?
Jules: +1. Thinking endpoints: 1) product search (relevance/rerank) 2) support triage (ticket routing) 3) product description generator.
Mara: Those map to buyer flows. Success metrics: precision@3 for search, avg handle time reduction for support, and CTR lift for descriptions.
Jules: Quick endpoint defs:
```
POST /v1/rerank/search -> input: query + candidates; output: scores/ranked_ids
POST /v1/triage/support -> input: ticket_text; output: category + urgency + routing_tag
POST /v1/generate/description -> input: product_attrs; output: marketing_blurb
```
Tanya: Proposed timeline: Week 1 = infra + security review; Week 2 = prompt & eval creation; Week 3 = integration + smoke tests; Week 4 = evaluation + handoff. Canary option: 10% traffic for 1 week.
Mara: Budget check — Alex, customer asked for a usage model with a monthly cap. Any number yet?
alex_retail: Budget roughly $35k for the 4-week pilot. Must pass SSO (SAML), EU data residency, and provide CSV audit logs. Also need a short NDA addendum.
Omar: Security notes: SAML is fine but we need SCIM for groups, KMS integration for customer keys, and explicit retention policy. Must attach SOC2 cert and data processing addendum. We'll require a simple pen-test questionnaire answered.
Jules: For eval prompts — draft suggestions:
- Search: "query: {q} | user_segment: {segment}" -> measure NDCG@10 on 200 queries
- Rerank: human judgments on top-5 for 250 queries -> precision@3
- Support triage: labeled sample for 500 tickets -> precision/recall by category
Mara: Can we reduce labeled tickets using active learning? 500 seems heavy.
Jules: Yes, propose active sampling to start at 250 labeled then expand to 400 if needed. Should still give stable metrics.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging at 1962504300 by @Jules.
Tanya: Action items (owner): 1) cost estimate (Jules) 2) security checklist doc (Omar) 3) draft prompt & eval set (Jules) 4) contract + SSO addendum (Legal) 5) customer to send sample data (alex_retail).
alex_retail: Will share anonymized product & ticket CSVs by next Tue. :thumbsup:
Mara: I'll update the POC plan doc and send calendar invites. If no blockers, we'll start security review Monday. Closing thread for now.
